translation.title: Analgesic and Anti-inflammatory Plaster
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for the analgesic and anti-inflammatory relief of bruises, sprains, muscle pain, joint pain, low back pain, stiff shoulders, neuralgia, and rheumatic pain.
translation.usage: Apply 1 to several patches a day to the affected area as appropriate.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine in the following cases: infants under 30 months of age; eczema; dermatitis caused by lacquer or the like; wounded areas. Consult a doctor or pharmacist before using this medicine in the following cases: people who have experienced allergic symptoms (such as rash, redness, itching or dermatitis caused by lacquer) from medicines or cosmetics; people with an allergic constitution; people with severe moist skin or erosion; children; women who are pregnant, may be pregnant, or are breastfeeding. Follow the prescribed dosage and directions. When it is used by a child, use it under the supervision of a guardian. This medicine is for external use only. If the affected area is wet with sweat or the like, wipe it dry before use. Do not warm the area where the patch is applied with a heater, an electric blanket or the like. Bathing with the patch on causes strong irritation, so remove it 30 minutes to 1 hour before bathing. If your symptoms do not improve after 5 to 6 days of use, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. If a large amount is absorbed through the skin, symptoms of poisoning may occur, so avoid using it on a large area for a long period. Stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist if any of the following occur: rash and redness; itching; swelling; pain. Store at room temperature, protected from moisture and light. Keep out of reach of children.
